decisions_made.description: user_id is nullable on corpora table (not pipeline_runs or seed_topics)
decisions_made.rationale: Playbook explicitly states 'user_id is nullable on investigation types (no auth in V1)'. Corpora is the top-level user-owned entity; child tables inherit via RLS policy JOINs rather than duplicating user_id
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: Agent 02 must never require user_id on corpora INSERT; RLS policies use JOIN through corpora.user_id for all child tables

decisions_made.description: SSE events defined as discriminated union in Section D rather than Section E (Pipeline Types)
decisions_made.rationale: SSE events are API-boundary artifacts consumed by the frontend (Section D domain), not internal pipeline stage I/O. Placing in Section D keeps the API contract co-located and enables IN-21 pattern (closed union prevents telemetry leakage)
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: Agent 04 must import PipelineSSEEvent from Section D; Agent 03a must emit only events matching this union — cannot add new event types without updating contracts.ts

decisions_made.description: Result<T> defined as type alias in Section G and re-exported from shared/result.ts, not as a Zod schema
decisions_made.rationale: Result<T> is a TypeScript structural type (discriminated union of {ok:true,value:T} | {ok:false,error:AppErrorShape}). Making it a Zod schema would require generic schema factories; the type alias approach avoids Zod v4 generic limitations while still being the single source of truth per BE-18
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: Consuming agents import Result<T> from @/types/contracts or @/lib/shared/result — never redefine inline. Zod validation of Result values uses the constituent schemas (AppErrorSchema)

decisions_made.description: Circuit breaker state stored on globalThis with M1 boundary tripwire comment
decisions_made.rationale: IN-19 pattern: module-level Map creates per-bundle isolation in Next.js. globalThis pins state to process. IN-20 tripwire comment documents the M1 constraint so the operator knows this is incompatible with autoscaled serverless before shipping
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: Agent 06 (Admin/Infrastructure) must evaluate M1 vs M2 deployment architecture decision before Agent 10 (Deployment); circuit breaker must be retrofitted to Redis/Supabase Realtime if multi-instance serverless is chosen

decisions_made.description: JSONB columns use jsonb_path_ops GIN indexes (not default jsonb_ops)
decisions_made.rationale: database-schema-design.md §2: jsonb_path_ops is 650% faster for containment queries and 3-4× smaller index size. All JSONB query patterns in this schema are containment queries (@>) not key-existence (?) queries
decisions_made.constraints_downstream: Agent 02 must use @> containment operators for JSONB queries, not ->> arrow operators (which bypass GIN indexes per database-schema-design.md §2)
